label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee bread feast celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, with 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Innkeeper, freight and builder jointly organized funding, baking, delivery, lighting and arrival arrangements. Baker knowingly supplied bread and oven access confidentially; secretary agreed to preserve the surprise and coordinate the scheduled arrival; neighbour knowingly promised secrecy and later agreed to welcome the mayor. The mayor learned of a community meal and its time/place, but the record does not show him being told its jubilee purpose or surprise preparations.
